chunks: O YOU WHO believe, fulfil your obligations. Made lawful (as food) for you are animals except those mentioned (here); but unlawful during Pilgrimage is game. God ordains whatsoever He wills.
ai.seo_question: What are the rules for eating meat and hunting during Hajj according to the Quran?
ai.summary: In Shia jurisprudence, this verse establishes the foundational principle of 'al-wafa bil-'uqud' (fulfilling contracts), extending beyond mere dietary laws to encompass all binding agreements, including marriage and trade. The specific prohibition of hunting during Ihram highlights the spiritual discipline required to maintain ritual purity, a concept deeply emphasized in the Ahl al-Bayt's teachings on the sanctity of the sacred months. This dual focus underscores the integration of legal compliance with spiritual mindfulness in Islamic practice.
